eeg102w_connect.message0: connect EEG102W EEG module timeout %1 s
eeg102w_connect.tooltip: Scan for and connect the EEG102W EEG module (BLE name KSEEG102), blocking at most the given number of seconds

eeg102w_raw.tooltip: Latest raw EEG value (protocol sample value divided by 10000)
